_comment: Template for tools/discord_bot/config.local.json - copy it and fill in real values ON THE BOX. The real file is gitignored because the token is a credential equal to the bot itself: anyone holding it can run every slash command below, including map changes and match restarts. Get the ids by enabling Discord Settings > Advanced > Developer Mode, then right-clicking a server / channel / role and choosing Copy ID. There is deliberately NO rcon password here - the bot reads it from dedicated.cfg so there is one copy to rotate.

_notes.adminRoleId: Required. Gates every command that changes the server (say, map, restart, pause, resume). Read-only commands (status, players) are open to the guild.
_notes.relayChannelId: The ONE channel whose messages are relayed into the game. Leave empty to disable the relay entirely. Every other channel is ignored.
_notes.relayRoleId: Optional. Empty means anyone who can post in the relay channel can talk to players in game - fine for a private channel, wrong for a public one. Set it to require a role.
